aiReviewAgent.prompt: Review the document "{title}": first call context_room_document_read to load the full text, then identify 3-5 concrete spots most worth improving (structural gaps, flawed arguments, missing counterexamples or supporting data, factual risks, ambiguous wording). For each one, call context_room_document_comment_add: quotedText must be a verbatim plain-text excerpt from the body (no Markdown markers, roughly 20-80 characters) for anchoring, and pass blockId when the block can be identified; body states the problem and a concrete fix in one or two sentences. At most 5 comments per review. Ground the review in the recalled Room memories and user background: prefer suggestions that fit the user's goals, preferences, and project context; when the text conflicts with newer facts, progress, or decisions found in memory, flag it as a priority issue. When done, summarize your review conclusions as a short list.

documentCursorCompletionAgent.correction: If there is an obvious typo immediately before the cursor, correct it according to the Skill protocol; otherwise, only add content after the cursor.
documentCursorCompletionAgent.formatRule: Format rules: apply the one that matches blockType and formatContext in <EDITOR_CONTEXT>. Code block (blockType codeBlock, formatContext.codeLanguage / codeLinePrefix): complete only raw code inside the current block, preserve the current line indentation, add line breaks only when needed, use at most 160 characters, and do not add code fences or language markers. List item (formatContext.list: type, depth, checked): complete only the current item text, use at most 80 characters, do not add line breaks, and do not output list markers, checkboxes, or a new item. Heading (formatContext.headingLevel): complete only the current heading text, do not output #. Blockquote: do not output >. Table cell: do not output table separators or create rows or columns. Plain text block: complete only one phrase or sentence in the current block, at most 80 characters, without line breaks or new blocks. When the current text has marks (including inline code), output the text itself without repeating Markdown formatting markers or backticks. When <EDITOR_CONTEXT>.completionMode is paragraph: continue the current text block with 2-4 complete sentences, at most 300 characters in total, without line breaks or new blocks; the 80-character single-sentence cap does not apply. In any mode, if avoidText is provided (a suggestion the user just rejected), do not output the same or similar content. When the text at the cursor is empty (for example a new list item or new paragraph just created by pressing Enter), output the concrete content to insert itself; do not output a description, plan, or explanation of what to write, and do not output template markers such as <CURSOR /> or <PREFIX>.
